meta.name: Mama Boy
meta.description: Xiao Hong is a shy 29-year-old man who works in an aquarium fish store and lets his overprotective mother boss him around in all aspects of his life. His cousin decides to take him to a seedy hotel where Sister Lele oversees the prostitution business.
meta.slogan: A shy young man who finds himself attracted to a single mother, at a sex hotel.
